title: MZ DRAGONS FORGE - FAST TRAVEL PLUGIN

posts.author: smileking
posts.body:
This is a RPG MAKER MZ plugin that allows devs to easily set up a fast travel system
here
.
Commands -
Add A New Fast Travel Location, Allows the developer to add a new fast travel position, that allows the selection of a ID (name of the fast travel), map, x pos, y pos, direction, and a map type (like a tag that decides what fast travel locations are, for multiple basically areas with area specific fast travel)
Remove A Fast Travel Location, Allows the developer to remove a existing fast travel point by checking a ID in all the lists.
To Disable a fast travel location, Allows the developer to disable a existing fast travel point by checking a ID in the Active list.
To Activate a fast travel location, Allows the developer to activate a existing fast travel point by checking a ID in the disabled list
and Show Locations, brings up a window to actually fast travel, this menu on activation allows the developer to check a value of Area Types, which it will look through the fast travel points and check their map type and if it matches the area type it will appear
Activated Fast Travel points show before disabled ones!
License -
This Plugin is available for commercial and non commercial projects no matter if you put money or not into this! Just be sure to keep the license that comes with it!
Reason why I made this -
I made this because i felt like it, and it would benefit my own project later on!
